summary: node1 now has persistent nftables rate limiting for new IPv4 and IPv6 SSH connections: 6/minute per source with a burst of 4. Authenticated administrative SSH remains available, and configuration persistence was verified across a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Generated SSH host keys, authorized the managed cluster administrator key, and enabled sshd.
Installed and enabled a persistent nftables ruleset targeting new TCP/22 connections.
Functionally tested rate limiting before and after reboot; both tests limited 6 of 10 rapid attempts while allowing ordinary SSH access.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed and all required state recovered.
Removed the temporary test credential; the managed administrator key remains authorized and verified.

evidence.summary: Rules passed syntax validation. Before and after reboot, bounded 10-connection bursts produced 4 successes and 6 rate-limited failures with increasing nftables drop counters.
Authenticated SSH as arch succeeded through the firewall; final state shows sshd enabled, active, and listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 22.
nftables and sshd are enabled. The same configuration hash and live IPv4/IPv6 rules were present before and after reboot.
